gary_2026_10_23_spooky_civic_ai_hackatho.title: Spooky Civic AI Hackathon - Build Weekend
gary_2026_10_23_spooky_civic_ai_hackatho.label: Tech / AI
gary_2026_10_23_spooky_civic_ai_hackatho.summary: Gary's Guide: Demos are Sunday at Demo Day. RSVP for that separately: luma.com/3perce-pi2u Spooky Civic AI Hackathon: Build AI Tools for NYC Free. Open to everyone. No approval needed, just RSVP. Fri Oct 23 - Sat Oct 24, in person in NYC or on Zoom. Come solo & we'll help you find a team. Free food for in-person builders. Who can come? Anyone who wants to build something for New York City: engineers, product managers, designers, people who used to code, & people who never have. The best teams pair people who know a problem with people who can build the tech. Builders write the code & ship the tool. Problem-solvers (PMs, designers, policy & community folks) pick the problem, shape how people will use it, & lead the pitch. No team? No problem. Most people come solo. You can meet teammates at our Oct 14 & Oct 15 classes, or at Friday's kickoff. Pick a track The Existential Track: Climate & Sustainability. Heat, waste, food access, cleaner air. Urban Nightmares: Housing, Healthcare, Education & Justice. Tenant rights, benefits, school help, legal info in plain English. Ghost in the Machine: AI infrastructure & scaling. Build the parts under civic AI tools, like search, data, & agents that keep them running. Physical AI for Good: Build AI that moves, with robot arm kits on site. No robotics experience needed. You leave with a working prototype, a demo video, & a real project for your portfolio. Mentors will be on hand all weekend. Where: NYC venue announced soon. The Zoom link goes to everyone who RSVPs. Partners: Robot arm kits & on-site mentors from Viam. Food & builder API credits from Vonage. Costumes encouraged. In-person spots are limited, so RSVP now. Sponsorship inquiries: Partner with 3percentclub About Viam: Viam is a New York-based software platform for building, deploying, & managing robotics & AI in the physical world. Viam is supplying robot arm kits & on-site mentors for this hackathon. About Vonage: Vonage, part of Ericsson, builds communications APIs for voice, video, messaging, & verification that developers put into their apps. Vonage is providing food & builder API credits for this hackathon. About 3percentclub: 3percentclub is an NYC nonprofit that teaches free AI classes for underrepresented builders: engineers, career changers, product managers, designers, & people who have never coded. This event is open to everyone. Want to go deeper with AI? Apply to the free AI Architect Fellowship for weekly classes, mentorship, & a community to build with. The AI Collective is a global non-profit building the human layer for the AI era. We unite 1,000,000+ leaders, builders, & stakeholders across 300+ forums worldwide to democratize the frontier, build trust, & coordinate how society navigates the rapid acceleration of technological progress. All attendees & organizers at events affiliated with The AI Collective agree to our privacy policy & are subject to our code of conduct.

gary_2026_10_23_ai_founders_operators_in.summary: Gary's Guide: Join us for an evening of conversation, connection, & startup legal education for founders, investors, & members of the startup ecosystem. 7:00-8:00 PM | Mocktail Hour Meet fellow founders, investors, & startup professionals over drinks in a relaxed setting. 8:00-8:45 PM | Legal AMA We'll have a dedicated legal educational session exclusively for you to ask the legal questions that have been on your mind. We'll break down topics such as startup law, fundraising, equity, founder relationships, intellectual property, hiring, contracts, & other common legal issues, while sharing practical insights through an interactive Q&A. Come with questions. The formal event ends at 9:00 PM, but the space will remain open until midnight. Feel free to stay, continue networking, collaborate with other attendees, or get some work done. Who this is for: Founders & startup executives Investors evaluating or supporting early-stage companies Operators & startup team members Advisors & service providers working with startups We kindly ask that everyone support the venue by purchasing at least one drink. More importantly, we hope you leave having made a few new connections along the way. About the Hosts "No unemployed brokies not building anything." TechBrig: TechBrig is an AI product design & development partner for early-stage startups & venture-backed companies. We help teams build & scale software, from MVP to growth. techbrig.co Book a call with the founder Ad Hoc Founders Counsel (Bagchi Law PC), a legal practice focused on founders & early-stage companies navigating growth, structure, & everyday legal roadblocks. founderscounsel.law Schedule a consultation Disclaimers: The legal presentation & AMA are intended for general educational discussion. Any information shared during the event is not legal advice & does not create an attorney-client relationship. Professional photography & videography will be taking place throughout the event. By attending, you acknowledge & consent to being photographed and/or recorded. Photos & videos may be used in event recaps, on social media, & in future promotional & marketing materials. By registering for this event, you consent to receiving future communications from the event organizers, including updates about upcoming events & related programming. You may opt out of these communications at any time.

gary_2026_10_26_monday_founders_coworkin.title: Monday Founders Coworking Pod
gary_2026_10_26_monday_founders_coworkin.label: Startup / Business
gary_2026_10_26_monday_founders_coworkin.summary: Gary's Guide: If you're an early stage founder, building alone is hard. You lose momentum, get stuck with no one to ask, & there's no one checking if you actually did what you said you'd do this week. We're a small group of founders working together for the month - think study group, but for building. We help each other, check in, & keep each other on track. Now we're opening it up to more people, in pods of 3-5. Here's how it works: you tell your pod what you're trying to get done, & they hold you to it. Stuck on something? Someone in the pod probably knows the answer. Starting to slip? Someone notices. Same faces every week, so you're never starting over with strangers. This is an outgrowth of our Wednesday coworking events - just smaller. We're here to build the idea & building culture NYC deserves. We focus on that foundational layer of relationships & community that allows for ideas to spread & building to happen. Enough of the transactional networking. Product first, business second. Cohort is a community of founders, builders, creatives, & researchers in NYC, & the Monday pod is our small-group coworking ritual. Let's build. More from Cohort Keep building, exploring ideas, & meeting the community. Find your next gathering below. gary_2026_10_26_the_shortlist_founder_sh.title: The Shortlist Founder Showcase
gary_2026_10_26_the_shortlist_founder_sh.label: Startup / Business
gary_2026_10_26_the_shortlist_founder_sh.summary: Gary's Guide: The Shortlist NYC - October Founder Showcase (#10) The Shortlist is back for our monthly Founder Showcase & the room keeps getting better. This is a monthly curated, application-only evening connecting early-stage founders with exceptional operators across New York. No panels. No pitches to VCs. Just six founders building breakout companies, a room full of people who've built things themselves, & the kind of candid conversation you don't get at most events. Each founder will share what they're building, why it matters, & the specific roles they're actively hiring for right now - followed by a mixer. What to expect: Founders presenting at the seed through Series B stage. Operators, builders, & executives who've seen what good looks like. An intentionally small room designed for real connection. Who this is for: Exceptional operators - whether you're actively exploring your next role, casually curious, or simply want to stay close to what's being built in NYC right now. Founders will be announced in the days leading up to the event. Attendance is intentionally limited. Apply to be considered. More information on The Shortlist can be found here. Founded by Andrew Yeung & Ivor Straford.

gary_2026_10_27_founder_pitch_clinic.title: Founder Pitch Clinic
gary_2026_10_27_founder_pitch_clinic.label: Startup / Business
gary_2026_10_27_founder_pitch_clinic.summary: Gary's Guide: Join us at Fabrik NYC in DUMBO, Brooklyn for an in-person, hands-on pitch clinic designed to help founders become more confident on stage & sharpen the way they pitch to investors. Whether you are preparing for a fundraising round, an investor meeting, or your next demo day, you will learn practical tools to communicate your story with greater confidence, clarity, & impact. The clinic features two focused, 30-minute workshops covering how you show up & what you say. Don't Calm Down with Dave Wolovsky In this interactive workshop, Dave will share practical exercises to help you compose yourself when pitching, work with pressure rather than against it, & perform with greater presence in high-stakes moments. Dave is a Cognitive Performance Coach with an MS in Neuroscience & Education from Columbia University. He coaches founders on focus & daily energy management & serves as a StartX accelerator mentor. Learn more at https://effortwise.com/founders. The Art of Pitching to Attract Investors with Anthony Rose Anthony will break down how to communicate your vision & opportunity & present your business in a way that resonates with investors. Anthony is the founder & CEO of SeedLegals, the legaltech platform used by more than 50,000 startups to get investment-ready, run funding rounds, & handle legal needs. Before SeedLegals, his career included leading BBC iPlayer. Wired Magazine's 2009 cover story called him The Man Who Saved the BBC. Come ready to learn, practice, & leave with techniques you can use in your next pitch. The room seats 100. Hosted by SeedLegals, Meera Mawkin, Dave Wolovsky, & Fabrik NYC. Presented with Propel Earth Original event & registration details https://luma.com/dehgirvb The exact address is available after registering on the original Luma page.

gary_2026_10_27_decoders_dinner.title: Decoders Dinner
gary_2026_10_27_decoders_dinner.label: Tech / AI
gary_2026_10_27_decoders_dinner.summary: Gary's Guide: If you like thinking about tech & markets as much as you like a good meal, come hang out. Tech x Market Decoders runs small, salon-style sessions where a group researches a live tech or market question & argues it out together - think signal vs. noise, applied in real time. gary_2026_10_28_startup_pitch_mixer.title: Startup Pitch Mixer
gary_2026_10_28_startup_pitch_mixer.label: Startup / Business
gary_2026_10_28_startup_pitch_mixer.summary: Gary's Guide: Join our event in New York! We design Pitch & Networking nights to help founders sharpen their thinking through direct, candid feedback & to give strong investors access to serious teams. Our pitch night is complemented by a structured networking session before & after the pitch session. What to expect: Startups pitch live & receive focused feedback from angels & VC partners Structured networking session before & after the pitches Entrepreneurs, startup founders, & operators are joining to network, exchange ideas, & build strong connections Active investors & venture scouts joining to discover the best startups early Who you will meet at the event: Founders Investors, VC partners, Venture Scouts Marketers, Salespeople, Business Advisors Industry Disruptors AI Experts Entrepreneurs from Europe, Asia, & the United Kingdom We Welcome New Investors: We invite investors to our event to expand their network, get acquainted with new startups, evaluate them, share feedback, & participate in discussions with early-stage & serial founders. We offer complimentary tickets to institutional investors, angels, & venture scouts with a proven track record. If you'd like to access our database of promising startups or provide mentorship support to our best startups, please fill out this short Investor Application Form, & our team will contact you. Want to Pitch? A limited number of founders will have the opportunity to pitch their startup or business to a panel of investors & experts. 4-6 selected founders will pitch their startup, followed by a short Q&A where participants can ask questions & share feedback. Apply by filling out the Pitch Application Form & sending us your pitch deck. Spots are limited, & we select founders in advance. To maintain high-quality pitches, you are required to present with a pitch deck. We will share our pitching guide and, if you'd like, coach you so you're fully prepared for pitch night. The best startups will be featured across our social media & included in our investor newsletter. Requirements for attendees: Dress code: smart casual. Bring good energy. Join our event & secure your ticket today! About us: Startup Valley is a global event organizer hosting pitch nights in 25 cities since 2023. Since then, we have hosted 850 events for 40,000 attendees. Over these years, we connected countless outstanding early-stage startups to serious investors, & we are not planning to stop. We maintain strategic partnerships with VC funds in the US, Europe, & Asia to support our community. Do you have a question, a partnership proposal, or want to clarify something? Reach us at hello@startupvalley.club Agenda 18:00-18:30 - Registration: Guests register, receive badges, & event programs. This is an opportunity for casual networking, making first connections, & preparing for the event. 18:30-19:00 - Event Kickoff & Interactive Networking: Official welcome from the organizers with a brief overview of the event goals & schedule. Interactive networking session to connect with key contacts. 19:00-19:50 - Startup Pitch Session: Startups present their projects to investors & experts. Each team has 5 minutes to pitch, covering the project's core idea, business model, & target market. 19:50-21:00 - Chill & Networking: Participants enjoy casual conversations with investors, discuss collaboration opportunities, & exchange ideas over refreshments. FAQ Can I pitch? Yes! To pitch, please purchase a Pitch Ticket & fill out the Pitch Application Form. We will contact you to discuss & approve your pitch. The pitch duration is 5 minutes. You will also have some time to answer questions from the audience. How does the pitch go? Selected founders present on stage to the audience & the investors in the room. You get 5 minutes to pitch your idea, business model, target market, & investment ask, followed by a short Q&A. The best startups are featured across our social media channels & in the investor newsletter. Who will I meet? Founders, angel investors, VC partners, venture scouts, AI experts, engineers, operators, marketing & sales experts, & international entrepreneurs from across Europe, Asia, & the US. Do investors get free tickets? Yes! Please apply above or email hello@startupvalley.club, & we will issue a complimentary ticket for you & your team. Can I request a refund? Yes. Refunds are available if requested at least 1 day before the event start time. Please submit the refund request on the platform where you purchased your ticket, or email us at hello@startupvalley.club

jc_culture_43584_2026_11_05_flame_the_ex.summary: Flame (The Experience) for a one night only event presented by Ruby Hawk Productions and Art House Productions in Jersey City, New Jersey. Based on Brown’s 2021 poetry collection Flame, which tells the story of a failed twin flame romance, Flame (The Experience) takes the poetry off the page and brings it to life through a sizzling, multi-sensory theatrical experience told through sight, sound, monologues, and movement.

jc_culture_10003576_2026_11_11_hamilton_.title: Hamilton Park Farmers Market 2026
jc_culture_10003576_2026_11_11_hamilton_.label: Festival / Market
jc_culture_10003576_2026_11_11_hamilton_.place: Hamilton Park, 9 McWilliams Pl., Jersey City, NJ
jc_culture_10003576_2026_11_11_hamilton_.summary: Join us at the Hamilton Park Farmers Market, your midweek destination for fresh, local, and thoughtfully crafted food and goods. Each week, we’re proud to feature farm-fresh produce from Stony Hill Farm alongside a curated selection of specialty vendors. Browse a variety of offerings including our long time vendor Pickles and Olives, fresh seafood from Scale Fish Market, and prepared foods perfect for dinner. You can also find baked goods, candles, personal care products, and more. You can even take advantage of convenient services like on-site knife sharpening while you shop. On the first and second Wednesdays of each month, enjoy live entertainment that adds to the vibrant, community atmosphere of the market. Whether you’re shopping for the week, grabbing a bite, or simply enjoying the park, the Hamilton Park Farmers Market is a welcoming space to connect with local vendors and neighbors.

jc_culture_42883_2026_11_18_jodeci_jerse.title: Jodeci – Jersey City

jc_culture_42883_2026_11_18_jodeci_jerse.summary: Get ready to experience an unforgettable night as Jodeci takes the stage for their highly anticipated concert, “”Jodeci – Jersey City,”” at the iconic Landmark Loews Theatre. Nestled in the heart of Jersey City, this historic venue boasts a stunning atmosphere that perfectly complements the smooth R&B vibes of the legendary group. With its grand architecture and intimate setting, the Loews Theatre is the ideal backdrop for an evening filled with soulful melodies and nostalgic hits. Join fellow fans for a night of electrifying performances that will have you singing along and dancing in your seat. The energy will be palpable as Jodeci delivers their timeless classics and new favorites, making this a must-see event for R&B lovers. Don’t miss out on this chance to witness music history in the making—secure your spot now and be part of the magic at Jodeci – Jersey City!
